description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Starts writing a draft post for every slot of a builder campaign that has none yet. CHARGES EMBERS, up to the returned `estimate.embers`; a balance too low is refused up front (402 insufficient_credits) and nothing is charged. Confirm the cost with the user before calling. Runs in the background; calling again only fills slots still without a draft.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/builder/{id}/generate.)

brandId.description: Brand to act in. A brand-bound key acts in its own brand (another brandId is 403); an account-wide key defaults to the owner's active brand.

name: generate_campaign_drafts
title: Generate a campaign's drafts (charges Embers)
